title: #073. Job-Shop Scheduling (JSSP) via CP Disjoint
subtitle: Model multi-machine job routing using Pumpkin's native disjoint global constraint and operation precedences to minimize makespan.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { starts, makespan }.
judge.m1: Field "starts" must be a 2D array with {p0} job rows.
judge.m2: starts[{p0}][{p1}] must be a non-negative integer (received {p2}).
judge.m3: Job {p0} precedence violated: operation {p1} ends at {p2}, after operation {p3} starts at {p4}.
judge.m5: Reported makespan ({p0}) does not match maximum completion time ({p1}).
judge.m6: Valid schedule, but makespan ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
